// Request: A robust full-stack Todo application utilizing a React frontend styled with Tailwind CSS and an Express REST API backed by Prisma and SQLite. The application features comprehensive CRUD task management with optimistic UI updates, multi-status filtering and keyword search, persistent theme toggling (dark/light mode), and robust input validation. It is engineered with TanStack Query for seamless server-state synchronization and Sonner for interactive user toast feedback.

INFERRED FEATURE SPECIFICATIONS (implement ALL of these):
- Task CRUD Operations with Optimistic UI: Allows users to create, read, toggle completion, and delete todos. Implements optimistic updates via TanStack Query to ensure the UI updates instantly before server confirmation, rolling back automatically on error. [@tanstack/react-query, axios, lucide-react] (User interaction → Local cache update (optimistic UI) → Axios HTTP request → Express route → Prisma ORM → SQLite DB update → UI refetch/reconciliation)
- Express REST API & Database Integration: A secure, validated RESTful API with endpoints for GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE operations. Built with Express, schema validation via Zod, and data persistence with Prisma ORM targeting a SQLite database. [express, @prisma/client, zod, cors, dotenv] (Client Axios request → Express router → Zod validation middleware → Prisma client interaction with SQLite → JSON response with proper HTTP status codes)
- Persistent Dark & Light Mode Theme Toggle: Provides an accessible theme toggle switch that persists user preference in LocalStorage and dynamically applies class names to the HTML root node for Tailwind CSS dark mode styling. [tailwindcss, lucide-react] (User toggles switch → State updates → Theme value written to LocalStorage → React updates DOM documentElement class List → Tailwinds styles re-rendered)
- Client-Side Search and Status Filtering: Enables users to search tasks via text search inputs and filter them by status (All, Completed, Active) with smooth transition animations and an intuitive empty state display. [framer-motion] (User inputs search query or switches filter tab → React updates query state → Frontend filters the fetched server todo array → Filtered list rendered to screen)
- Form Validation & Toast Notification System: Validates todo title lengths client-side to prevent empty or overly long tasks. Emits toast notifications for successful creations, toggles, deletions, and any network error states. [react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, zod, sonner] (User submits todo creation form → React Hook Form + Zod validates schema → (If invalid) display error indicator → (If valid) trigger API call & display loading/success/error Toast)

Required libraries: @tanstack/react-query, axios, lucide-react, express, @prisma/client, zod, cors, dotenv, tailwindcss, framer-motion, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, sonner

Feature folders: backend/prisma, backend/src/routes, backend/src/controllers, backend/src/middleware, frontend/src/components, frontend/src/hooks, frontend/src/context, frontend/src/services

Each feature listed above is REQUIRED. Do not omit any of them.
Implement every data flow end-to-end. No mocked data. No placeholder UI.


DESIGN SYSTEM — MANDATORY USAGE:
A design system has been pre-generated at src/design-system/.
You MUST import reusable components from there:
  import { Button, Skeleton, EmptyState } from '../design-system/index.js';

Design Language for this project: elegant (inspired by Linear/Vercel/Stripe)
Color palette: blue brand + slate neutral
Spacing: 8px grid (multiples of 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16...)
Border radius: md (consistent across ALL components)
Font: Inter

FORBIDDEN UI PATTERNS:
  ✗ Different border radii on different components (e.g. some rounded-2xl, some rounded-lg)
  ✗ Arbitrary gradient backgrounds not matching the brand palette
  ✗ Buttons larger than 56px height
  ✗ More than 4 different font sizes in a single view
  ✗ Inconsistent spacing that breaks the 8px grid
  ✗ Excessive glassmorphism (max 1 blur panel per page)
  ✗ Missing hover/focus/active states on ANY interactive element
  ✗ Icon-only buttons without aria-label
  ✗ No visible focus indicator (outline-none without focus-visible replacement)

REQUIRED UI PATTERNS:
  ✓ Every interactive element has hover + focus-visible state
  ✓ Destructive actions show a confirmation step before executing
  ✓ Every async operation has a loading skeleton (not just a spinner)
  ✓ Every data-absent state has an EmptyState component with a call-to-action
  ✓ Error states show the actual error message + a recovery action
  ✓ All inputs have labels (visible or aria-label)
  ✓ Responsive at sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px) breakpoints
